context:
Land as a single consumer of the already-scaffolded db.ts - no
refactor of db.ts itself. Note the out-of-date docstring reference
to "bench.manifest" in db.ts; the actual attached name from
duckdb_builder.py is `bench.results` (benign to leave for now, but
worth a drive-by comment fix). Facet counts via a single GROUP BY
probe per load keeps the cold-start snappy - do not push counts to
server-side aggregation. All user input in the SQL path is
untrusted: use parameterised queries for the filter→SQL path, and
rely on READ_ONLY for the textarea path.
description:
Phase C of the Results Explorer strategy revision
(plans/purring-jingling-petal-ultraplan).

Add a new `/results/query` page: faceted filter panel + flat sortable
table + optional SQL textarea, backed by `results.duckdb` via
DuckDB-WASM. Models the CloudSpecs (cloudspecs.fyi) pattern of very
fast filter + pivot over a canonical result set.

The pipeline already emits `results.duckdb`, and `src/db.ts` already
initialises DuckDB-WASM in the frontend - no consumer exists yet.
This item is the consumer.

Depends on explorer-pipeline-meta-leaderboard-widening for the
`results_schema.json` sidecar so the column picker doesn't hardcode
the list.

anti_patterns.why: results_schema.json is emitted by the pipeline specifically to avoid this

anti_patterns.dont: introduce CodeMirror or a SQL syntax highlighter
anti_patterns.why: scope says 'parity with benchbox results --sql, no new deps'

preserves.behavior: Existing routes remain reachable - /results/query must be registered before /results/:benchmark so it isn't shadowed
queryRows<T>() helper at db.ts:78 continues to be the sole query entry point from this page - no parallel DuckDB client
src/db.ts initialises DuckDB-WASM with ATTACH READ_ONLY - do not weaken this; SQL textarea relies on it for safety

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run typecheck && npm test

verifications.expected: /results/query loads; applying platform=DuckDB filter narrows rows; sort by geomean_ms works; CSV export row count matches corpus-inventory filter count; SQL textarea runs SELECTs; DDL/DML errors out

work_units.notes:
results-explorer/src/App.tsx - register
`<Query path="/results/query" />` BEFORE the benchmark-wildcard
route so it isn't captured by /results/:benchmark.

New file: results-explorer/src/lib/queryFilters.ts. Given a
FilterState object, produce a safe SQL string (or prepared
statement args) against `bench.results`. All user-provided
values parameterised - never string-concatenated. This module
is also what the SQL textarea's "build from current facets"
button emits.
work_units.summary: Build queryFilters.ts: filter state → parameterised DuckDB SQL

work_units.notes:
Left sticky panel. Facets: benchmark, platform, SF, tuning
mode, trust tier, date range, has_cost, validation_status.
On load, run one DuckDB GROUP BY probe per facet (or a single
multi-column CUBE) and display counts next to each option.
Each facet is a checkbox group backed by useUrlState so the
full filter is shareable.
work_units.summary: Facet panel with counts (single GROUP BY probe on load)

work_units.notes:
Center column. One row per bundle from bench.results. Column
picker reads results_schema.json (emitted by the pipeline -
see explorer-pipeline-meta-leaderboard-widening w3) so the
frontend never hardcodes _COLUMNS. Default visible columns:
benchmark, platform, SF, date, power_score, geomean_ms,
trust. Sort by any column, ascending/descending.
Row → /results/r/{result_id}.
work_units.summary: Flat sortable results table + column picker (reads results_schema.json)

work_units.notes:
Button: "Download CSV". Exports the currently-filtered set
(not the full table). Uses the DuckDB-WASM Blob path already
scaffolded in db.ts - no new deps.

Collapsed <details> under the table. Plain textarea (no
CodeMirror - parity with `benchbox results --sql`, no new
deps). Runs via `queryRows<T>()` (db.ts line 78). Read-only
guarantee comes from DuckDB's existing
`ATTACH ... (READ_ONLY)` at db.ts:57.
work_units.summary: Advanced mode: plain <textarea> SQL editor, read-only enforced by ATTACH READ_ONLY

work_units.notes:
src/pages/__tests__/Query.test.tsx. Smoke tests:
  - facet GROUP BY probe produces expected counts for a fixture
    results.duckdb
  - filter → table row set matches a reference SQL
  - sort toggle reverses order
  - CSV export round-trip (parse exported CSV, assert row count
    matches visible rows)
  - SQL textarea runs and renders a result table; DDL/DML
    statements error out (ATTACH READ_ONLY)
work_units.summary: Vitest coverage: facet counts, sort order, CSV round-trip, SQL textarea
